evaluation.short_description: Task-specific ACT and RGB-based hybrid controllers covering all ten RoboSynChallenge tasks. The release preserves per-task checkpoints, adapters, auxiliary predictors, calibration files and trajectory assets.
evaluation.technical_notes: Run from the repository root with eval.sh or run_task.py against a pinned official RoboSynChallenge checkout. The suite uses task-specific execution horizons. Six ACT entries currently use output/execution chunk 50/50, which conflicts with the portal validation rule execution_chunk_size < output_chunk_size; organizer guidance is required before entering these fields. sample_loading accesses env.unwrapped.robot FK/IK and also requires organizer approval.

input.note: Several ACT adapters also consume qvel/qf, which the current portal does not expose as separate choices. Disclose this in technical notes.

evaluation.blocking_reason: A single truthful execution_chunk_size and gripper_threshold cannot yet be entered for this task-specific suite. Do not invent values or change policy behavior to satisfy the form.
